subject: Critical: MerchantPay onboarding — coverage amendment request
messages:
From: Oliver Grant <oliver@merchantpay.co>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>
Cc: MerchantPay SRE <sre@merchantpay.co>
Date: Fri, 30 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Critical: MerchantPay onboarding — overnight P1 coverage

Hi Rachel,

We're seeing a spike in intermittent P1 issues during the 00:00–06:00 PST window since we started routing live traffic to the new webhook endpoints. Our SREs have traced a subset to brief model-serving timeouts and a failover path that needs clearer handoffs.

MerchantPay's compliance team is pushing us to guarantee 24/7 response escalation while we stabilize the integration over the next 3 weeks. Right now our contract assumes Redwood's standard business-hours routing for P2s and extended P1 coverage only for critical incidents. Given the frequency, we need a short-term coverage amendment: a dedicated overnight on-call slice with a defined escalation path and guaranteed P1 response within 15 minutes.

Can Redwood commit to a temporary change (3 weeks) and share a single-point runbook we can share with our engineers? If there are cost implications or an approval workflow on your side, please flag those.

We attached a short incident timeline and logs.

Thanks,
Oliver
Oliver Grant
Head of Integrations, MerchantPay
[Attachment: merchant-pay-incident-log-20261029.zip (zip)]

From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>
To: Oliver Grant <oliver@merchantpay.co>
Cc: MerchantPay SRE <sre@merchantpay.co>
Date: Fri, 30 Oct 2026 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Critical: MerchantPay onboarding — overnight P1 coverage

Hi Oliver —

Thanks for the heads-up and the log bundle. I’m sorry you’re hitting these time windows. We want to avoid impacting your go-live and can support a time-limited coverage amendment while we stabilize the webhook path.

Proposal (short-term, 3 weeks):
- Redwood will provide a dedicated on-call responder between 00:00–06:00 PST for MerchantPay-originating incidents.
- P1 response SLA: initial acknowledgement within 15 minutes; targeted remediation updates every 30 minutes until mitigation.
- Routing: MerchantPay incidents will go to the dedicated rotation first; escalation to our engineering pager (and to your SRE group) if unresolved after 60 minutes.
- Deliverables: a concise runbook (attached) and a proposed on-call rotation CSV.

Two asks from your side: 1) confirm the 3-week window start date, and 2) grant our on-call responder access to the MerchantPay incident context (links/keys) per the runbook.

I’ve attached the runbook draft and a proposed rotation. I’ll loop in support leadership for approval.

Attachment: merchant-integration-runbook-v1.pdf (draft)
Attachment: proposed-oncall-rotation-merchantpay.csv

Best,
Rachel Kim
Senior Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference
rachel.kim@redwood.com
Phone: +1 (415) 555-0192

From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 31 Oct 2026 08:30:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Critical: MerchantPay onboarding — overnight P1 coverage

Vivek / Ben — forwarding MerchantPay’s ask. TL;DR: spike of P1s overnight in their integration window; they want a 3-week temporary overnight on-call rotation with a 15-min P1 ack SLA. I drafted the runbook and a proposed rotation (attached).

Operational considerations I want us to confirm:
- Effort: one dedicated responder per night (00:00–06:00 PST). I put 7 nights into the CSV (rotation of 3 responders ideally).
- Escalation: after 60 minutes escalate to engineering pager + MerchantPay SRE. Should we shorten to 45 if we think the incidents will escalate fast?
- Cost/credits: this is extra operational burden. MerchantPay is a strategic mid-market customer; suggest offering a partial onboarding credit vs. charging standard overnight support uplift. Approvals needed from you to commit.
- Access: MerchantPay must provide runbook links and temporary keys per the runbook; we need SOC2 checklist sign-off to enable that.

Attachments: merchant-integration-runbook-v1.pdf, proposed-oncall-rotation-merchantpay.csv

Can you confirm if you approve the temporary amendment and any changes to the escalation window? If approved, I’ll follow-up with legal for a short contract addendum and notify MerchantPay of the start date.

—Rachel
Rachel Kim
Senior Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 02 Nov 2026 16:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Critical: MerchantPay onboarding — overnight P1 coverage

Rachel — thanks for the clear proposal. Approve the temporary 3-week overnight coverage with the following modifications:
- Keep P1 ack time at 15 minutes.
- Shorten escalation to engineering pager to 45 minutes (we’ll try to resolve faster at the on-call layer).
- Offer a one-time onboarding credit equal to two weeks of standard overnight uplift (communicate as a goodwill credit; Finance will record as an SOW amendment).
- Before start, verify MerchantPay has completed the SOC2 checklist items in section 2 of your runbook and granted the minimal incident-access tokens.

Rachel, please proceed: 1) confirm start date with Oliver, 2) get MerchantPay to sign the simple addendum (I’ll ask Legal to prepare it referencing the attached runbook), and 3) publish the rotation to the on-call schedule. Ben — loop in platform if you need more hands for overnight shifts.

Vivek Kulkarni
Head of Support, Redwood Inference
vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com
[Attachment: approval-note.txt]
